errors.evidence: The x-axis description omits labels or units and incorrectly states they are not present. Labels may be present but not clearly defined in the description.
The description does not adequately state the clear purpose or title of the chart, which is indicated by the caption, focusing more on changes rather than the specified purpose.
Description states the orange line reaches around 5,000, but the line maintains below 10,000 consistently.
Description states the yellow line reaches around 10,000, but it stays well below 10,000.
Description states the blue line reaches around 170,000, but visually it appears to end closer to 160,000.
Description states the grey line reaches around 190,000, but visually it appears to end near 160,000.
The description does not mention the absence of markers and specific styles such as the dense solid lines displayed.
